title.en: Fictional BHWE profiles and verification questions
title.fil: Kathang-isip na BHWE profiles at verification questions

purpose.en: Explain conditions and service-count distinctions using fictional records, without adjudicating a learner.
purpose.fil: Ipaliwanag ang kondisyon at service-count distinctions gamit ang fictional records, nang walang paghatol sa learner.

group_size.en: Pairs or groups of 3–5; observe individuals.
group_size.fil: Magkapareha o pangkat na 3–5; obserbahan ang bawat isa.

materials.en: Fictional Cards A–C from the lesson guide, four-condition sheet and blank question cards; no private documents.
materials.fil: Fictional Cards A–C sa lesson guide, four-condition sheet at blankong question cards; walang private documents.

steps.en: Compare Card A’s eight total years with three accredited years, then Card B’s reported qualifying facts; neither card is CSC approval.
steps.fil: Ihambing ang walong total years at tatlong accredited years sa A, saka ang reported qualifying facts sa B; hindi CSC approval ang mga card.

steps.en: Use Card C’s uncertainty to ask about continuity, evidence and the actual JO/COS arrangement; invent no ruling.
steps.fil: Gamitin ang uncertainty sa C upang itanong ang continuity, evidence at aktuwal na JO/COS arrangement; huwag mag-imbento ng ruling.

steps.en: Explain one card to a partner and write one bounded CSC question naming the period, evidence and uncertainty.
steps.fil: Ipaliwanag ang isang card sa kapareha at sumulat ng tiyak na CSC question na may panahon, ebidensiya at uncertainty.

debrief.en: Which facts are stated, which need verification, and why is eligibility separate from appointment?
debrief.fil: Anong facts ang nakasaad, ano ang dapat tiyakin, at bakit hiwalay ang eligibility sa appointment?

observe.en: Use the aligned lesson indicator for the explanation; activity participation or an online click alone does not establish competency.
observe.fil: Gamitin ang aligned lesson indicator sa paliwanag; hindi sapat na competency evidence ang participation o online click lamang.

output.en: One explanation and a specific question for the responsible CSC office.
output.fil: Isang paliwanag at tiyak na tanong sa kaukulang CSC office.

alternative.en: Facilitator models Card A, then pairs explain B or C with a reference sheet; no personal disclosure.
alternative.fil: I-model ng facilitator ang A, saka ipaliwanag ng magkapareha ang B o C gamit ang reference sheet; walang personal disclosure.

worksheet.en: Stated facts / accredited-service period / evidence or uncertainty / CSC question
worksheet.fil: Nakasaad na facts / accredited-service period / ebidensiya o uncertainty / CSC question

title.fil: Kathang-isip na follow-up at practice note; form demo adapted
title.en: Fictional follow-up and practice note; form demonstration adapted

purpose.fil: Magsanay sa facts, specific question, clarification at bounded next step.
purpose.en: Practise facts, a specific question, clarification and a bounded next step.

group_size.en: Pairs or groups of 3–5; observe individuals.
group_size.fil: Magkapareha o pangkat na 3–5; obserbahan ang bawat isa.

materials.fil: Fictional learner/staff cards, blangkong note at panulat; walang real forms o ID.
materials.en: Fictional learner/staff cards, blank note and pens; no real forms or IDs.

steps.fil: Rotate learner, contact at observer sa tatlong rounds (15 min): facts/unknowns, tanong, ulitin at linawin ang sagot.
steps.en: Rotate learner, contact and observer through three rounds (15 min): facts/unknowns, question, repeat and clarify the response.

steps.fil: Observer feedback at re-practice (10 min), saka check/reflection at next-contact note (5 min). Kasama sa 45-minute share, hindi dagdag.
steps.en: Observer feedback and re-practice (10 min), then check/reflection and next-contact note (5 min). Included in the 45-minute share, not additional.

debrief.fil: Ano ang nakumpirma, ano ang nananatiling unknown, at anong next contact ang nilinaw?
debrief.en: What was confirmed, what remains unknown and what next contact was clarified?

observe.fil: Module objective index3 / indicator4; lesson objective index0. Obserbahan ang facts, tanong, clarification at bounded next step; hindi accent o damdamin.
observe.en: Module objective index3 / indicator4; lesson objective index0. Observe facts, question, clarification and bounded next step; not accent or feelings.

output.fil: Fictional practice note; walang private application details.
output.en: Fictional practice note; no private application details.

alternative.fil: Written o supported question; omitted ang official form demo hanggang verified ang download at trainer guidance.
alternative.en: Written or supported question; official form demonstration omitted until download and trainer guidance are verified.

worksheet.fil: Fictional pakay / confirmed response / natitirang tanong / agreed next contact
worksheet.en: Fictional purpose / confirmed response / remaining question / agreed next contact
